evidence_slice: Historic England's official National Heritage List for England v02 'Listed Building polygons' layer is a public no-login esriGeometryPolygon feature layer released under the Open Government Licence, with ListEntry, Name, Grade, CaptureScale, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields and GeoJSON query support. A distinct single-record query targeted ListEntry 1266928 (Exeter Grammar School). The parameterized feature response was inaccessible through the available retrieval channel, and a direct network request failed at DNS resolution before any feature payload was read. No polygon coordinates or returned record attributes were inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer 3 is officially declared esriGeometryPolygon and supports GeoJSON, but the exact ListEntry=1266928 response was not retrievable; no polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.identity: The exact query targets official NHLE ListEntry 1266928; the layer schema binds ListEntry, Name and Grade in the same feature when a response is returned.
field_evidence.type_use: The targeted official list entry is Exeter Grammar School; however the feature payload was not read, so no record was accepted.
